crossRefs.note: She conceived again, and bore a daughter. Then he said to him, “Call her name Lo-Ruhamah; for I will no longer have…
When its boughs are withered, they will be broken off. The women will come and set them on fire, for they are a people…
I will dash them one against another, even the fathers and the sons together,” says Yahweh: “I will not pity, spare, or…
For Yahweh says, “Don’t enter into the house of mourning. Don’t go to lament. Don’t bemoan them, for I have taken away…
Therefore I will also deal in wrath. My eye won’t spare, neither will I have pity. Though they cry in my ears with a…
As for me also, my eye won’t spare, neither will I have pity, but I will bring their way on their head.”
Then Yahweh’s angel replied, “O Yahweh of Armies, how long will you not have mercy on Jerusalem and on the cities of…
So then, he has mercy on whom he desires, and he hardens whom he desires.
See then the goodness and severity of God. Toward those who fell, severity; but toward you, goodness, if you continue…
For judgment is without mercy to him who has shown no mercy. Mercy triumphs over judgment.
When Yahweh spoke at first by Hosea, Yahweh said to Hosea, “Go, take for yourself a wife of prostitution and children…
When Joram saw Jehu, he said, “Is it peace, Jehu?” He answered, “What peace, so long as the prostitution of your mother…
“But draw near here, you sons of a sorceress, you offspring of adulterers and prostitutes.
You do the works of your father.” They said to him, “We were not born of sexual immorality. We have one Father, God.”

translations.web: Indeed, on her children I will have no mercy; for they are children of unfaithfulness;
translations.bsb: I will have no compassion on her children, because they are the children of adultery.
translations.kjv: And I will not have mercy upon her children; for they be the children of whoredoms.
translations.asv: Yea, upon her children will I have no mercy; for they are children of whoredom;
